mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation (thread_id, user_id, title, status) VALUES (#{threadId}, #{userId}, #{title}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0

SELECT c.*, (SELECT LEFT(m.content, 80) FROM ai_message m WHERE m.conversation_id=c.id AND m.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_preview FROM ai_conversation c WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.is_deleted=0 AND c.status != 0 ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=0 AND status != 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET message_count=message_count+#{delta}, last_message_at=#{lastMessageAt}, updated_at=#{lastMessageAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
UPDATE ai_conversation SET is_deleted=1, status=0, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) + 1 FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message (conversation_id, user_id, sequence_no, role, content, status, client_message_id, trace_id, model_name, token_usage, latency_ms, grounded) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{clientMessageId}, #{traceId}, #{modelName}, #{tokenUsage}, #{latencyMs}, #{grounded})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_message WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT * FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND client_message_id=#{clientMessageId} AND role='user' AND is_deleted=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND sequence_no=#{sequenceNo} AND role='assistant' AND is_deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_message SET content='正在思考…', status=0, trace_id=#{traceId}, model_name=NULL, token_usage=NULL, latency_ms=NULL, grounded=0 WHERE id=#{id} AND role='assistant' AND is_deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message_source (message_id, source_type, source_id, chunk_id, source_title, source_url, snippet, score, rank_no, metadata) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{chunkId}, #{sourceTitle}, #{sourceUrl}, #{snippet}, #{score}, #{rankNo}, #{metadata})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_message_source WHERE message_id=#{messageId} ORDER BY rank_no, id
